title: AMERICA'S 10
MOST POPULOUS
STATES

hook.say: America's ten most populous states, ranked. The top three hold over a quarter of all Americans!

outro.say: Is your state on the list? Comment below!

outroLines: IS YOUR STATE ON THE LIST?

items.name: Michigan
items.say: Number ten: Michigan, touching four Great Lakes. Ten-point-one million people.
items.cap: Number ten: Michigan, touching four Great Lakes. 10.1 million people.

items.name: North Carolina
items.say: Nine: North Carolina, and growing fast. Eleven-point-two million people.
items.cap: Nine: North Carolina, and growing fast. 11.2 million people.

items.name: Georgia
items.say: Eight: Georgia, the Peach State. Eleven-point-three million people.
items.cap: Eight: Georgia, the Peach State. 11.3 million people.

items.name: Ohio
items.say: Seven: Ohio, birthplace of seven presidents. Eleven-point-nine million people.
items.cap: Seven: Ohio, birthplace of seven presidents. 11.9 million people.

items.name: Illinois
items.say: Six: Illinois, home of Chicago. Twelve-point-seven million people.
items.cap: Six: Illinois, home of Chicago. 12.7 million people.

items.name: Pennsylvania
items.say: Five: Pennsylvania, the Keystone State. Thirteen-point-one million people.
items.cap: Five: Pennsylvania, the Keystone State. 13.1 million people.

items.name: New York
items.say: Four: New York, home of America's biggest city. Just over 20 million people.
items.cap: Four: New York, home of America's biggest city. Just over 20 million people.

items.name: Florida
items.say: Three: Florida, it passed New York in twenty fourteen. Twenty-three-point-five million people.
items.cap: Three: Florida, it passed New York in twenty fourteen. 23.5 million people.

items.name: Texas
items.say: Two: Texas, the Lone Star State. Thirty-one-point-seven million people.
items.cap: Two: Texas, the Lone Star State. 31.7 million people.

items.name: California
items.say: And number one: California! Thirty-nine-point-four million people, more than one in nine Americans.
items.cap: And number one: California! 39.4 million people, more than one in nine Americans.
